name: The Dali EDITION
insider_take: Where surrealist artistry meets the mystical landscapes of Yunnan — The Dalí EDITION redefines luxury in one of China's most enchanting ancient towns.
whats_special: Nestled in the heart of Dali Old Town , a UNESCO-recognized historic gem on the shores of Erhai Lake , The Dalí EDITION seamlessly blends the EDITION brand's signature contemporary elegance with the rich Bai ethnic culture of Yunnan. The hotel's architecture draws inspiration from traditional Bai courtyard design — think whitewashed walls, carved wooden accents, and open-air gardens — while delivering world-class amenities. At over 6,500 feet above sea level, guests enjoy a dramatically clear sky, fresh mountain air, and sweeping views of the Cangshan Mountains .
pro_tip: Visit between March and May for the legendary Dali International Butterfly Festival and blooming cherry blossoms along Erhai Lake — the scenery around the hotel is absolutely breathtaking during this window.
dont_miss: Don't miss a sunrise cycle along the Erhai Lake Trail — just minutes from the hotel — where the still waters mirror the Cangshan Mountains in a scene straight out of a painting. Back at the hotel, the signature spa offers treatments rooted in traditional Yunnan herbal therapies, a one-of-a-kind experience you won't find anywhere else in the EDITION portfolio.
